summary: Frontend testing of Quick Filters on My Business page and Notification → IncomeAmountModal flow. All features tested and working correctly.

features_tested.feature: Quick Filters on My Business page: All/Fixed/Variable filter buttons visible
features_tested.evidence: All 3 filter buttons visible with data-testid attributes: filter-all, filter-fixed, filter-variable
All (12) - shows 12 business cards when clicked

features_tested.feature: Quick Filters: 'Fixed' shows only fixed income types
features_tested.evidence: Fixed (4) - shows 4 businesses (Qnet, My Consultancy Business, Velvique, Gas Agency)

features_tested.feature: Quick Filters: 'Variable' shows only variable income types
features_tested.evidence: Variable (8) - shows 8 businesses (Test Variable Business, TestVarBiz_Feb23, velvet, etc.)

features_tested.feature: Notification Bell visible on home page
Notification Panel opens on bell click
features_tested.evidence: Notification drawer slides up with income_reminder notification for 'velvet' income

features_tested.feature: Notification shows income reminder with expectedAmount
features_tested.evidence: Notification shows 'Time to record velvet' with 'Expected: ₹10,000'
Modal opens with entity name 'velvet', expected amount ₹10,000 in green

features_tested.feature: IncomeAmountModal shows entity name and expected amount
features_tested.evidence: Header shows 'velvet', subtext shows 'Expected: ₹10,000' in green color
Input field visible with ₹ prefix and data-testid='income-amount-input'
Green 'Save Income' button visible with data-testid='save-income-btn'

features_tested.feature: Save Income button creates transaction successfully
features_tested.evidence: Entered ₹9,500, clicked Save - success toast 'Income saved successfully!' appeared, modal closed

features_tested.feature: Number to words conversion in modal
features_tested.evidence: When entering 9500, shows 'Rupees Nine Thousand Five Hundred Only'

backend_code_review.details: Function auto-records fixed income transactions based on frequency (Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, Half-Yearly, Yearly, Others). Checks if transaction already exists for today before creating new one. Creates notification after auto-recording.
Function auto-records insurance premium expense transactions. Supports One-Time, Monthly, Quarterly, Half-Yearly, Yearly frequencies. Checks premium end date and policy end date before recording.
Background scheduler runs daily checks for due premiums and fixed income auto-recording at startup/date change.

seed_data_creation: Created income transaction for 'velvet' business with amount ₹9,500 via IncomeAmountModal
context_for_next_testing_agent: Quick Filters (All/Fixed/Variable) are working on My Business page. Filter counts match actual records. Notification → IncomeAmountModal flow is fully functional: bell → drawer → click notification → modal opens with entity info → enter amount → save → success toast. Auto-record functions for fixed income and insurance premiums are implemented in backend scheduler.
